title: SuperAI: Merging Capabilities Across Heterogeneous Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.15322v2 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Enabling the reuse and composition of knowledge and capabilities distributed across foundation models is an important step toward building scalable artificial intelligence (AI) systems. However, architectural differences and incompatible representations make it difficult to transfer and integrate these capabilities through a unified cross-model interface. To address this challenge, we propose SuperAI, a cross-architecture multi-model fusion framework that integrates complementary capabilities from multiple source models into a host model through orthogonal alignment of low-dimensional task-relevant representations. translated_title: SuperAI：跨异构基础模型的能力融合
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.15322v2 公告类型：new 摘要：实现分布于各基础模型之间的知识与能力的复用和组合，是构建可扩展人工智能（AI）系统的重要一步。然而，架构差异与不兼容的表示方式，使得通过统一的跨模型接口来迁移和整合这些能力变得十分困难。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了SuperAI——一个跨架构的多模型融合框架，它通过低维任务相关表示的正交对齐，将多个源模型的互补能力整合到一个宿主模型中。具体而言，我们首先使用共享锚点样本从源模型和宿主模型中提取任务相关表示，并应用主成分分析（PCA）构建维度相同的低维功能子空间。接下来，我们使用正交Procrustes映射将源模型与宿主模型进行对齐，从而实现跨异构架构的能力迁移与融合。
tldr: 提出SuperAI跨架构多模型融合框架，利用共享锚点样本提取任务相关表示、PCA构建同维低维功能子空间，并通过正交Procrustes映射实现异构基础模型之间互补能力的融合迁移。
en_tdlr: SuperAI is a cross-architecture multi-model fusion framework that merges complementary capabilities from heterogeneous foundation models into a host model via orthogonal alignment of low-dimensional task-relevant representations, using PCA-based functional subspaces and orthogonal Procrustes mappings.
